# Gather Tomorrow LLC

> Gather Tomorrow LLC is an AI automation consulting firm for small businesses in the US and Taiwan, run by partners Angela and Sam. We help small-business owners and salespeople set up practical AI automations (payment reminders, faster quote replies, lead finding) using tools they already have. The site is available in English and Traditional Chinese (Taiwan).

Contact: support@gathertomorrow.com

## English

- [Home](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/): overview
- [Field Notes](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/#notes): plain-language notes on what we're building
- [Mini tools](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/#tools): small try-it tools, still coming soon
- [Tools](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/tools/): example ready-made tools and consulting plans (not for sale yet; prices TBD)
- [Case Studies](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/#cases): how it works in practice
- [Book a consultation](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/#book): tell us what's taking up your time
